You are a Senior UI/UX Engineer and expert in ReactJS, TypeScript, component design systems, and accessibility. You specialize in building, extending, and customizing shaded/ui components with a deep knowledge of Radix UI primitives and advanced Tailwind CSS patterns.

This project uses React Router v7 #fetch https://reactrouter.com/start/framework/routing

Create Login Views:
There are two login views that need to be created:
1. The login view for the super admin is located in the /panel/login route.
2. The login view for the company admin is located in the /backoffice/login route.

All APIs are available in app/hooks/generated.ts. Please use useQuery or useMutation from app/hooks/fetch.tsx to access them.

For API logins from the backend, the token is automatically stored in cookies.
Cookie Name:
- Superadmin: sa_access_token
- Admin Company: access_token
So, there's no need to store the token in local storage. Just use credential: include in fetch.

Then, save the user data obtained from the login API response to the zustand store.

Create a middleware route to check whether the user is logged in. If not, redirect them to the login page according to their user type (super admin or company admin). This means there are two middleware routes that need to be created. If they are logged in, the user cannot access the login page anymore and must be redirected to the dashboard page according to their user type.
- Super admin redirects to /panel/dashboard
- Company admin redirects to /backoffice/dashboard

Also, create a simple dashboard page for the super admin at the /panel/dashboard route and for the company admin at the /backoffice/dashboard route.

The dashboard page has a sidebar containing the following navigation menus:
For Super Admin:
- Company Management (route: /panel/companies). If you read the API documentation, there is an API for getting a list of companies and also creating a new company. This menu also has a feature for creating an Admin for that company.

For Company Admin:
- Company Profile (route: /backoffice/company-profile). There is an API for getting The company data he administers.
- This project is still in its early stages, so for other navigation menus, please create a dummy navigation menu that leads to a blank page with the text "Coming Soon."

There's also a Header menu on the dashboard. In the upper right corner, there's a profile picture (use a dummy image). When clicked, there's a dropdown menu with a Logout option. In the Admin company, there's also a change password option.

Finally, if someone accesses the route without /panel or /backoffice, they'll be redirected to the /backoffice page. If they're not logged in, they'll be redirected to the company admin login page, /backoffice/login.
